list.title: Networks
list.emptyDescription: Add the CPA/CPL networks your offers belong to.

form.description: Networks are the CPA/CPL partners your offers belong to.
form.postbackUrlHint: Where FLOX itself sends a request when one of this network's conversions changes status — to an ad source, for example. Leave empty if you need none. Macros like {click_id} and {status} are filled in.
form.currencyHint: When a postback sends an amount without a currency, FLOX takes it to be in this one. Without it, that revenue would be left out of reports.
form.acceptDuplicatesHint: By default FLOX records each status once per click (a redeposit once per transaction id) and drops repeats. Some partners re-send the same status on purpose — turn this on only if this network needs it. A status still never moves back to hold.

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters

rowActions.archiveConfirmDescription: Archived networks are hidden from offer/flow pickers going forward. Existing flows that already reference this network keep working. This can be reversed later.

postbackSecret.title: Incoming postback secret
postbackSecret.description: Save it now: the secret is shown once. Give this URL to “{{name}}”.
postbackSecret.urlLabel: URL for the network, with the secret

incoming.title: Incoming postback — for the network
incoming.description: Enter this URL in the network's dashboard: it is how the network tells FLOX about registrations, deposits and rejections.
incoming.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the text and copy it yourself
incoming.macrosHint: Replace the values in braces with your network's macros (for example click_id={sub1}, revenue={payout}). {secret} is this network's secret.
incoming.secretHint: The secret is shown once, when the network is created. If you did not keep it, get a new one: the old one stops working and the URL in the network's dashboard has to be updated.
incoming.confirmDescription: The old secret stops working at once: postbacks carrying it are refused until you update the URL in the network's dashboard.
incoming.noTrackerTitle: The tracker address is not set
incoming.noTrackerDescription: The platform has no public tracker address (TRACKER_PUBLIC_URL), so FLOX cannot show the URL. Contact the platform administrator.

params.secret: Required. The network's secret — without it the postback is refused.
params.click_id: Required. The FLOX click id: the network gets it in the offer link when that link carries the {click_id} macro.
params.status: Required. The status in the network's terms — it has to be in the mapping below.
params.revenue: The payout, a number with a dot. Without it the conversion carries no money.
params.currency: The amount's currency (USD, EUR…). If it is not sent, FLOX takes this network's payout currency: {{currency}}.
params.txn_id: The network's transaction id. Needed for repeat deposits: without it a second deposit on the same click counts as a duplicate.
params.event_time: When the conversion happened (unix time or ISO 8601). Without it, when the postback arrived.

incoming.noStatusesDescription: No network status is mapped to a FLOX status — every postback from this network will be refused.
